settings.nativeComparison: Bundled licenses, app/OS version copy, port notes, source and upstream issue links, documentation and diagnostics. Upstream donation, Discord, Crowdin, privacy-policy and anonymous user-ID controls are not reproduced as port services.
Custom shortcuts, conflicts, recording, import/export and reset. Commands also use native menus; not every upstream action is individually configurable through the native shortcut editor.

Settings JSON export/import/editor, folder handler, bounded memory thumbnail cache and clear/disable controls. Login launch uses SMAppService; background lifetime and menu-bar access are implemented. Login registration was not changed during QA. Finder desktop and other applications’ Open/Save dialogs remain system components.

Theme/accent/background, compact rows, image opacity/stretch/alignment, native font and backdrop, tab actions, shelf toggle, toolbar/status visibility, separate counts and persistent Operations access. Arial and Sidebar material visually checked. Arbitrary upstream per-resource theme colors are not individually editable.

IDE app picker/test/launch and repository IDE action. GitHub account stores an opt-in PAT in Keychain and uses a host-scoped credential helper. This differs from upstream OAuth device authorization. Empty/disabled account UI and malformed-input rejection checked; live account authentication not tested.

Hidden/dotfiles/extensions, thumbnails, selection checkboxes, single-click preferences, new-tab folders, confirmation policy, extension warning, hover selection and empty-space Up. Previous-folder selection, size units and asynchronous local folder-size calculation implemented/tested. Folder-size/date UI checked. Windows protected-file/ADS semantics differ; natural-language search integration is not implemented.

Language/date format, restored or specific startup pages, foreground/background tabs, dual-pane defaults, Home widgets, context-menu visibility, scroll inertia/tab-wheel direction and restart. Recent files/network/tag widgets and date format inspected. External folder URLs currently open in the existing application instance; a separate-instance preference is not implemented.

Shared layouts, per-folder or synchronized presentation, default sort/group/direction/date units, adaptive media threshold, size cycling, columns and auto-fit. Details initial column sizing fixed and visually checked so Date/Type/Size/Cloud remain visible.

Localized section/label search, matching headings and an explicit empty-search state. Generated index tracks search keywords; native grouped settings replace the upstream navigation/control hierarchy.

Saved named/color tags, validation, metadata-preserving rename/remove, saved-tag picker and indexed tag browser. Creation/color UI and preservation tests pass. Global changes depend on Spotlight indexing and retain catalog entries on failure. Native Finder colors and name-based metadata differ from arbitrary upstream colors and stable tag-ID semantics.

Context-specific ordered entries, add/remove/reorder, search, visibility, apply/discard, reset, persistence and JSON transfer. Prior UI checks cover editing; exact upstream control equivalence is not certified.
